{"subject":"Meridian Health Partners: recap of today's validation session","body":"Hi Aisha, Leo and Nora,

Thanks for the time today. In the sandbox, the incremental readmission pipeline ran in nine minutes on the de-identified extract, and each row shows its top three drivers.

Open on our side:
- SSO: Marcus will take the nested mhp_roles claim question to our identity team today and get Leo something he can put in front of Raj. Apex maps flat claims today.
- Written SSO design for the committee.
- Encryption whitepaper to Nora.
- Jordan will check whether the demo recording can be shared and come back to Nora.
- Security packet to Aisha, copying Raj, ahead of the October 9th committee.

On your side: procurement sends the vendor questionnaire.

We noted the question of notifying care managers when someone drops off the list as one to work through with Nora's care management team.

We will hold off on a meeting until you have seen the SSO answer.

Jordan","customer_value_line":"The incremental pipeline supports your goal of moving the readmission list from weekly to daily, so care managers can call patients the morning after discharge.","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U027","excerpt":"The whole goal is daily.
